answer: Delayed-draw identity lottery.** An agent gets a slot only if a future random value, drawn from a public beacon after registration closes, maps it into the admitted set; seed material is committed to an onyx log beforehand so the attacker can't forge a favorable preimage. Each candidate must first commit a yarrow-sealed deposit, then wait through the draw. Unselected deposits return minus a delay fee; selected identities must re-commit fresh randomness each epoch.
